recommendations.name: Message encryption
recommendations.rationale: RSA is broken by Shor. ML-KEM replaces RSA's key-transport role; the shared secret becomes the AES key.
recommendations.tradeoffs: Payload grows by about 1,088 B plus nonce and tag, so it is easier to detect. ML-KEM-512 is lighter; ML-KEM-1024 suits the longest-lived data.
recommendations.where_to_use: Wherever the sender used RSA to protect the message key.

recommendations.name: Frame-selection key
recommendations.today: SHA-256 of a passphrase, frames 0 to 255 only
recommendations.technique: 256-bit random key with HKDF or HMAC-SHA-256 frame selection
recommendations.quantum_role: symmetric: Grover halves 256 bits to about 128
recommendations.rationale: No PQC algorithm needed. Fix coverage so frames across the whole video can be chosen.
recommendations.where_to_use: Video project, where the embedding positions are chosen from a passphrase.

recommendations.name: Integrity
recommendations.rationale: Removes the CRC32 key-check oracle; tampering fails loudly.
recommendations.tradeoffs: Never reuse a nonce under the same key.
recommendations.where_to_use: Any place the payload is checked after extraction.

recommendations.name: Sender authenticity
recommendations.rationale: Sign the payload and verify on extraction. SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) is the conservative alternative with much larger signatures.
recommendations.tradeoffs: A 3,309 B signature adds to payload size and detectability.
recommendations.where_to_use: When the receiver must know who embedded the message.

recommendations.name: Hiding layer
recommendations.today: LSB or XOR-LSB, fixed start, no secret
recommendations.technique: Key-dependent pixel order, then measure steganalysis
recommendations.rationale: Hiding is measured by steganalysis and is not part of the quantum percentage.
recommendations.tradeoffs: A bigger PQC payload is easier to detect, so measure it.
recommendations.where_to_use: Both projects, independent of the encryption choice.
